name: MTN Nigeria
source: MTN Nigeria Communications Plc. Revenue from the NGX filing library H1 2026 earnings release and the audited FY2025 results. CRON 2026-11-06: Cost of Sales, Gross Profit and Operating Expenses corrected to the figures the issuer prints, and the H1 2026 cost lines added, all in NGN millions scaled to absolute naira. FY2025 earnings release, salient points table, read 2026-11-06: total revenue 5,202,957, expenses 2,460,864, cost of sales 688,269, operating expenses 1,772,595, EBITDA 2,743,765 (FY2024: revenue 3,358,461, expenses 2,047,431, cost of sales 528,185, operating expenses 1,519,246, EBITDA 1,313,399). Gross profit is revenue less cost of sales because the issuer splits its expenses into exactly those two lines: FY2025 5,202,957 less 688,269 equals 4,514,688, and 4,514,688 less 1,772,595 plus other income 1,672 equals the printed EBITDA 2,743,765; FY2024 3,358,461 less 528,185 equals 2,830,276, and 2,830,276 less 1,519,246 plus other income 2,369 equals the printed EBITDA 1,313,399. H1 2026 from the half year earnings release, read 2026-11-06: total revenue 2,993,064, expenses 1,319,544 made up of cost of sales 376,096 and operating expenses 943,449, EBITDA 1,673,519. Gross profit 2,616,968 is revenue less cost of sales; the segmental table in the same release prints a gross margin of 2,616,969, one million higher on rounding. The cells replaced were cost of sales 895,102 and 696,682 and operating expenses 0 and 0 for FY2025 and FY2024, none of which matched the printed lines, and the two zeros rendered as 0.0 on the panel. FY2021 to FY2023 are left as collected because each of those years already ties revenue less cost of sales to its stored gross profit and cost of sales plus operating expenses to its stored operating profit. Source URL https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/MTN_Nigeria_FY_2025_Earnings_Release.pdf | income tax row corrected from the issuer's audited statement so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column added from MTN Nigeria Communications Plc unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the nine months ended 30 September 2026 (NGX doclib filing library) page 12, group nine month column, NGN millions scaled to units. Revenue 4,613,323 is the printed revenue line; this issuer prints no cost of sales or gross profit subtotal, so those rows stay empty. Operating Expenses is the operating cost block below revenue less the direct network cost lines: values added services 36,193 plus starter packs, handsets and accessories 43,694 plus interconnect 139,694 plus roaming 8,004 plus transmission 25,015 plus commissions 214,376 plus advertisements 56,474 plus employee costs 186,797 plus impairment losses 23,872 plus other operating expenses 231,259 plus depreciation of property and equipment 340,279 plus depreciation of right of use assets 219,473 plus amortisation of intangibles 72,197, stored negative. Operating Profit 1,992,505. Finance costs 359,577 less finance income 82,579 is the net finance cost stored, and a printed net foreign exchange gain of 80,138 also sits between operating profit and profit before tax. Profit before taxation 1,795,645 less tax 630,471 equals profit for the period 1,165,174. EPS printed 55.60 naira. | CRON 2026-11-24: 9M 2026 Cost of Sales, Gross Profit and Operating Expenses added from the issuer Q3 2026 earnings release (doclib.ngxgroup.com, MTN NIGERIA Q3 2026 EARNINGS RELEASE, read 24 Nov 2026). Cost of sales is the printed direct cost total 566,526 (segment table); revenue 4,613,323 less 566,526 reproduces the printed gross margin 4,046,797 exactly; operating expenses 1,422,343 is the printed total operating expenses 1,988,869 less cost of sales 566,526. The stored 9M operating expenses cell previously read -1,344,727 and did not tie to either printed line, it is replaced. Amounts in NGN.
